svg.metadata: {"title": "Wi-Fi", "description": "A Wi-Fi QR code (phones join by scanning it), the network and password written out.", "fields": {"ssid": {"default": "Guest"}, "password": {"default": ""}, "security": {"default": "WPA", "help": "WPA, WEP or nopass"}, "hidden": {"default": "", "help": "yes: a hidden network"}}, "computed": {"qr": "WIFI:T:{{security}};S:{{ssid|wifi}};P:{{password|wifi}};{{#hidden}}H:true;{{/hidden}};"}, "example": {"ssid": "Guest", "password": "correct horse battery"}}
